FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: AI Detects Support at MA20 as Fundamentals Turn Bullish
tldr_points: USD/JPY exhibits a sharp intraday dip, presenting a tactical buying opportunity within a robust uptrend.
Strong US macroeconomic data, including a surprise 0.9% surge in August construction spending, underpins the USD.
Technical indicators show the pair holding well above the 20-day moving average, with RSI signaling persistent bullish momentum.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY dips to offer a strategic long entry as US economic resilience overrides minor ISM misses, keeping the uptrend intact.
FX.comment: Strong US construction data and bullish technical structure support buying the dip toward MA20 support.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] DOWN: Bond Selloff Pressure and Technical Break Below MA20
tldr_points: Bond yield resurgence pressures equity valuations.
Price sits below the 20‑day MA, signaling near‑term bearish bias.
Fundamental tailwinds from AI‑driven capex are offset by macro headwinds.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 faces downside risk as bond selloff resumes and price breaks under MA20 amid mixed fundamentals.
STOCKS.comment: Price below MA20 with rising yields favors near‑term downside.
